title: Britain's growth story is improving – but sustaining momentum will take more than investment
summary: As Barclays releases the latest edition of our Regional Investment Map, Abdul Qureshi, Head of Business Banking at Barclays, explores what the findings reveal about the UK's improving growth story, the rise of regional innovation hubs and why sustaining momentum will require more than investment alone.
body_markdown: **The Barclays Regional Investment Map** – produced by Barclays Eagle Labs and Beauhurst – provides insight into the funding landscape and growth in the number of companies across the UK. This map includes total UK company population and equity investment figures, by IS8 sector. Investment refers to ‘equity investment’, both for the UK totals and regional breakdowns.
